desc: Implement full sparse-table solution with fast I/O, two-pointer B computation, sparse-table RMQ, and per-query binary search.
Validate on the provided samples and edge cases: all equal sizes, length-2 intervals, intervals with no possible pairs, and large random inputs for performance.
If the sparse-table implementation hits time or memory limits, switch to the fallback custom segment-tree monoid that answers each query in O(log N) without binary search.
